resources.string: Files are read directly from this folder, the same folder the agent sees as /. Search, import and the session recycle bin are not available here.
The explorer does not fall back to the session private workspace. Check the folder and access permission, or choose another workspace above.
Folder workspaces have no session recycle bin. Files the agent deletes are backed up to the mounted folder recycle area; open External folders on the Files tab to restore them.
